agyos_skill.intent: Standard Operating Procedure for General & Administrative Pod (Finance, Legal, and Operations). Governs invoice reconciliation, legal risk review, and procurement requisitions under strict fiduciary controls.
agyos_skill.instructions: This standard operating procedure governs financial audits, legal agreement reviews, and operational procurement workflows. 1. **Intake & Fiduciary Classification**: - Classify analysis as R0 (read-only audit/review) or R1 (draft report). - Any external disbursements, banking mutations, or binding contract executions are strictly R3 and must be staged in the outbox as `PENDING_COMMIT`. 2. **Reconciliation & Analysis**: - Compare statements against general ledger accounts. - For legal reviews, extract indemnity, liability limits, and termination clauses with exact section references. - For procurement, compile vendor price/delivery matrix. 3. **Advisory Output Generation**: - Deliver findings clearly marked as internal drafts or advisory analyses. - Explicitly note that legal analysis does not constitute formal legal counsel. 4. **Approval Gate & Verification**: - Record snapshot of ledger and state before presenting changes to human operator.
